result.warmup_description: Physical shared-reference setup at one common curvature-limited speed for both cars and their 1.2m previews; actual own LiDAR histories; setup time and contacts scored
result.acceleration_measurement: finite difference of measured speed at 100Hz
result.reference_description: Shared locally lap-time-refined racing line; finite optimizer, not certified globally optimal

ego_planning_profile.candidate_reduction: retain a viable nominal path; search alternatives for blocked or stalled maneuvers
ego_planning_profile.activation: blocked side while losing ground to the observed rival
ego_planning_profile.fallback: short-horizon tracked rollout, lane hold, brake or certified creep
ego_planning_profile.lateral_search: first map wall on either side; no fixed offset cap

result.perception: ego LiDAR residual clustering and temporal tracking; own simulator localization
result.control_architecture: neural maneuver probabilities + geometric trajectory tracking + safety filter
